marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Stocks & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech leaders including Alibaba and Tencent expanded cloud infrastructure capex and rolled out new enterprise AI agent solutions during the trading session.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerating enterprise AI adoption in China is expected to drive higher cloud revenue growth and re-rate software valuation multiples over medium-term horizons.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace across non-tech enterprise clients and potential hardware supply constraint dynamics.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Path & Tech Valuations
marketLayer.fact: Recent US inflation data indicated steady moderation towards target levels, causing overnight swap markets to fully price in a 25 bps rate cut at the next FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: A lower risk-free yield environment lowers discount rates for long-duration growth assets, providing structural tailwinds for US megacap tech valuations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistently high corporate earnings growth expectations setting an elevated bar for upcoming Q2/Q3 earnings reports.

marketLayer.title: China Macro Liquidity & HK Financial Sector
marketLayer.fact: The PBOC implemented targeted reverse repo operations and signaled continued flexible monetary support to stabilize mainland economic recovery and liquidity conditions.
marketLayer.inference: Improved credit access and liquidity support provide a floor for valuation metrics of HK-listed mainland banks and insurance institutions.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Credit transmission efficiency to private corporate capex and persistent retail consumer caution.
